mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing a very warm day with clear skies and a high of ninety-one degrees, feeling like ninety-two at Verona Community Park. Tonight features a waxing crescent moon, and skywatchers can spot the International Space Station crossing the sky for five minutes starting at nine-thirty PM.

In city updates, Verona is encouraging eco-friendly habits. Apartment residents can drop off food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city is promoting sustainability through rebates for rain barrels, energy-efficient smart toilets, and offering a free online Eye-On-Water program to help track your water usage.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Louie on Friday, July seventeenth. Looking ahead, make sure to visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday, July twenty-second, at Hometown Junction Park for great local vendors and live music.

In police news, on Tuesday, July seventh, officers responded to an attempted alcohol theft at a convenience store on Prairie Oaks Drive. Thanks to an alert bystander who interrupted the theft, police later located the vehicle on Hometown Circle and arrested a seventeen-year-old girl from Oregon for absolute sobriety violations along with two underage passengers.

Culver's is currently closed but will open at ten AM today. Be sure to stop by for today's delicious Snickers Swirl, featuring rich chocolate and caramel. If you are planning ahead, tomorrow's mouth-watering flavor is Mint Cookie.
